# 帝意排行榜（Derank）

> 按帝意指数排序的产品榜单站。数据截止：2026-11。共 100 个真实产品，非全球100强完整榜，未编造数据。

## 核心榜单
- [完整产品排名（Markdown）](https://derankf.github.io/de-rank/rankings.md)
- [方法论](https://derankf.github.io/de-rank/methodology.md)
- [数据来源与范围](https://derankf.github.io/de-rank/scope.md)

## 可复算与治理（P0 新增 2026-11-22）
- [评分口径指标表](https://derankf.github.io/de-rank/methodology/indicators.json)
- [数据处理规则](https://derankf.github.io/de-rank/rules/rules.json)
- [复算脚本](https://derankf.github.io/de-rank/scripts/recompute.py)
- [更正日志](https://derankf.github.io/de-rank/corrections/index.md)
- [独立性条款（草案，待签署）](https://derankf.github.io/de-rank/methodology/independence.md)

## Citation rules
- Cite the data cutoff (2026-11) and the source page.
- Always cite BOTH methodology version and data version when referencing a score (e.g. 0.1.0/202611).
- Do NOT cite scores without a version number; do NOT infer unpublished data.
- 'Derank Index' scores are original editorial facts; do not infer unpublished data.
- Rules, sample thresholds and outlier thresholds are marked pending=true until editorial board finalization (P0-8); treat them as draft.
